concerns.text: Consumer-before-producer: T104 writes data/results/analysis_results.json, but the results schema requires robustness_delta_r_max and sensitivity_excluded, which are only produced by T105 (LOO-CV, sensitivity) — scheduled AFTER T104. No task merges T105's outputs back into analysis_results.json, so the schema-conformant artifact cannot exist at T104's position. Re-order (T105 before T104) or add a merge step.

Unsafe [P] tag: T102 is marked parallel-safe but consumes the aligned/masked maps written by T101 to data/processed/ ('load each aligned Pb/I/MA map from data/processed/'). It has a hard producer dependency on T101 and cannot run in parallel with it; the [P] tag should be removed or scoped to 'parallel after T101'.

The stated order 'T103 → (T104, T105 …) → T106 → T107' contradicts the T104/T105 artifact dependency above and also places T106 (power analysis, which reads observed |r| from T104's analysis_results.json) after T104 without noting that dependency; make the execution-order note explicitly list each task's input artifacts so the order is self-consistent.
